description: Audit an ERC-20 token on Base before you touch it: contract verification status, owner renounced or not, upgradeable proxy, holder count and top-holder concentration, malicious public tags, USD price, plus a sanctions check on the contract address itself. Returns a 0-100 risk score with named flags. Static + market-structure analysis from public data — zero-key, deterministic. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.

address.description: ERC-20 token CONTRACT address on Base (0x + 40 hex)

name: agentbit.token_risk
title: Token Risk Audit
